newsitem.title: JAPAN: Acom briefly rises to 1997 high in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Acom briefly rises to 1997 high in Tokyo.

text.p: Shares in Acom Co Ltd rose to a new trading high for this calendar year in Tokyo on Wednesday following the announcement that the firm would change company rules to enable it to buy back up to 14.66 million of its own shares.
As of 0435 GMT, shares in the Japanese consumer financing company were up 40 yen at 5,630 after earlier reaching a new 1997 high of 5,700 yen.
On Tuesday Acom announced that the company's annual shareholders' meeting on June 27 had approved a plan to change company regulations to carry out the share buy back.
